description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to property of intestate in Katukurunda, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520216
categorisation: This gazette notice deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land registration, property ownership transfer, and includes detailed land information (cadastral map number, parcel number, extent of land). The content falls under land administration rather than government personnel/structure, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
